avis.texte: Love this texture, smell and how it takes off my make up without irritating.
First time user and I'm very impressed. This product thoroughly cleanser the skin removing make up effectively. My skin feels comfortable and clean.
I use this as step 1 of my cleanse routine, it removes all of my make up but isn't harsh at all. My skin feels soft and has a really even tone to it. Definitely recommend

A non irritating cleanse even on eyes light enough not to clog the skin but gets rid of all make up. The little spatula is useful but does have a tendency to fly out of the packaging each time you open it. Maybe a better design would be something that folds open from the lid.
I've suffered from red cheeks and nose for years and years. The Erborian Products have really help me control the redness. I even have a glow now ! Love Erborian products.

I absolutely love this product. I massage a little into my face and leave it for around two minutes before rinsing off with warm water. It is brilliant at cleansing but also seems to really hydrate and leaves my skin beautifully clean and feeling nourished unlike other cleansing products which make my skin feel very dry.
Kind to sensitive skin, removes makeup well and is a good price for what you get. 3 months expiry is a very short amount of time for such a large product so I worry I won't use it all in time!!
This is definitely the best cleansing balm I have used Smells nice remove all the make You just need a little bit of product

avis.titre: Nice cleaning balm but wish had more foam
avis.texte: Like the smell of it, becomes warm liquid on the skin and the texture is very moist. I wish it had more foam though or maybe just balm is different texture to foam and needs a towel to apply with it for better cleaning

This cleansing balm is soft, with a subtle clean smell. It melts into your skins really easily and removes make up well. I'm using this alongside the Centella cleansing oil and gel and really like this range of products.
Unfortunately I used this product and it doesn't suit my skin it gave me a rash made my skin red

This is a beautiful cleansing balm, upon opening I was immediately met with a simply stunning scent, spa like and serene, however not overpowering. There balm itself looks solid however it melts like butter onto the spatula provided, and then into the skin. It absolutely destroys my mascara without stinging or leaving film on my eyes. My skin is left feeling supple and soft upon rinsing with a warm, wet flannel. It would be great if a flannel could come with the product!
Not too greasy like some balms can be, scented but not too much, a dream to apply and a dream to remove.
I really like the creamy texture and it really melts the makeup off. It doesn't hurt my eyes either!
Best cleansing balm I have ever used, great for removing makeup and leaving skin clean, fresh and soft.
I think this is lovely. Very easy to use and does not irritate the skin or eyes. I will use this from now on. Feel lovely and clean but does not leave my skin dry

avis.texte: I love the moisturising affect this cleanser has on my face, and a small amount goes a long way. I use a squeezed out warm cosmetic cloth to remove the balm once I've massaged it into my skin. Clan and soft is the result. Perfect!

avis.titre: Excellent for not drying out your skin
avis.texte: It's weird using something oily to clean your skin, especially when you have oily skin to begin with. This stuff is great tho! My skin actually feels clean, but still moisturized. It's cool.

I love the BB cream, it goes on nicely, has good coverage whilst still feeling light on the skin and lasts all day. I will definitely buy again.

I love this gentle cleansing balm! It removes all of my makeup (even waterproof mascara!) and leaves my skin feeling hydrated. The scent is pleasant. I have sensitive skin and didn't have any issues with this balm. #ErborianVIP

I love the finish of the BB cream. It barely looks like I'm wearing makeup but somehow my imperfections are blurred out and I look glowy but not greasy. It's easy to apply with my fingers or a sponge. My only gripe is the shade range. The lightest shade, "clair" is a bit too dark on me so I can only apply a very sheer layer or I look orange. I'm sure others will have an issue on the other end of the spectrum as well given that the darkest shade is "caramel". If this came in a lighter shade I would wear it every day!

avis.titre: Works great! My skin loves it
avis.texte: It works super well & boy does it do a good job! My skin feels smooth & nourished afterwards, it doesn't feel dried out at all. It does feel a bit thinker than what I'm use to using, but course bc it's a cleansing balm. I really do like it & I would keep buying it! Especially for the dry cold months of the year

This is my first time using a balm, and I really love the way my skin feels afterward, clean smooth and not tight. I am used to micellar water and this definitely feels like it is cleaning my face better, and more hydrating. I have sensitive skin and have had no issues at all with this balm! #ErborianVIP

This is a good mask that is lovely and cooling on the face , it makes the lines appear less and leaves a nice healthy glow . It a good one to use before a special event due to the nice glow it gives . I enjoyed using it .

This is my first time using a cleansing balm, and I'm kind of blown away that I haven't tried one before. As I get older, my skin has gotten drier and needs additional moisture. I tend to use micellar water and gentle cleansers to avoid zapping my skin of moisture but still removing all makeup and sunscreen. This is a great addition to my existing cleansers. I've been using it in the mornings with my PMD facial cleansing device to give my skin a good boost of moisture. It is amazing combined with the PMD! It has a fairly strong smell - so that might be something to consider if you are sensitive to smells. #ErborianVIP
My favourite go to for light coverage. It smooths and covers most redness with a surprisingly small amount. Love it :u1F970:

This is different! Not greasy, lathers, takes it all off, leaves your skin unbelievably soft, without grease or film. It's so easy to use, (read directions), no mess, no need for cotton or cloth, it rinses off clean. That was a pleasant surprise and the softness of my skin was also surprising. I had to touch it a few times. It also reduced the appearance of lines. I'm 59 and my skin is not perfect, Erborian just makes it look amazing. #ErborianVIP
It's a great cleansing balm, it removes all of your makeup perfectly without being harsh on your skin or eyes. I use waterproof mascara and it worked perfectly for me . #ErborianVIP

avis.titre: Ok for everyday, as long as it's not hot
avis.texte: Gives a nice natural finish when applied, but it didn't last on me. Began to get patchy, and shiny after a couple of hours. It lasted even less time in the 30 degree heat of London in the last day or two. It's ok for working from home days.
Perfectly removes all make up. Very soft, delicate texture and pleasant smell. After rinsing skin remains moisturized. #ErborianVIP

avis.titre: Very light and lovely emulsion for under make up
avis.texte: Lovely texture and very light weight ideal as base for make up. Smells so light and natural.
Centella removes mascara and face makeup effectively, but gently. With a subtle pleasing scent and velvety texture, I have found the perfect multi-tasking balm and my new favorite. #ErborianVIP
